title: [BUG] Condition needs to be modified to check if self.llm is either of LLM or BaseLLM classes
body:
https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/blob/a0fcc0c8d19d212e5b24cbcc3563ddcbb36d88cd/src/crewai/lite_agent.py#L212

Looks like the above condition is supposed to check if `self.llm` is an instance of either `BaseLLM` or `LLM`

I found this issue when I tried to used the guardrails with the `CustomLLM` class that is inherited from `BaseLLM`.

Requesting to please check this condition and update accordingly.

Thanks

linked_prs.title: Comparing BaseLLM class instead of LLM

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns the logic for handling LLM instances within an agent system, specifically referencing class inheritance for LLMs (BaseLLM, LLM, CustomLLM). It directly involves LLM operation and provider compatibility, which are core agent issue categories.
